messages:
Maya: FYI — customer (AcmeAI) escalated: all per-model throughput lines disappeared from Console dashboards after last night's metrics refactor. They still see total QPS but no model breakdown. Ticket #12345
Liam: Link + org? I can pull the dashboard queries.
Maya: https://console.redwood.ai/d/abc123/model-qps?org=acmeai — they said it worked at 01:30 UTC and broke around 02:00 UTC. P1 for them.
Tony: I saw a similar symptom in staging after PR #7897. TL;DR: exporter renamed labels (model_id -> model) and removed some legacy tags, panels still query by model_id so they return no series.
Maya: Oof. Customer is pushing for quick repro + mitigation.
Liam: Quick repro steps I'm running now:
```bash
curl -g 'http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[1m])) by (model_id)'
```
Liam: That returns an empty vector for the cluster that ingests AcmeAI metrics. Running the same by (model) returns series.
Tony: Confirmed — label rename. Deploy bot shows: 
"metrics-refactor" deployed at 2026-03-16T01:45:12Z — change notes: rename label model_id -> model, drop label team.
sre-bot: Alert: dashboards referencing model_id will show no series after label rename.
Maya: Customer asked for an ETA on fix. Options?
Liam: Options: 1) Revert the exporter change (breaks forward progress) 2) Update dashboards/alerts to use new label "model" 3) Add a compatibility relabeling rule in Prometheus to synthesize model_id from model for legacy queries. Fastest with least blast radius is #3 as a hotpatch.
Tony: I can add a Prometheus recording rule to copy the metric grouped by the new label into a legacy series. Example recording rule (hotpatch):
```yaml
- record: redwood_requests_by_model_id
  expr: sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[1m])) by (model)
  labels:
    model_id: "$1"  # placeholder: populate from 'model' label via relabel or template in our rule generator
```
Tony: Alternatively a relabel_configs block on the scrape job could set model_id = model, but that requires reload and risk if misapplied. Recording rule is safer.
Liam: I'll push the recording rule to prometheus-rules (hotfix branch) and reload. Then update the dashboard to point at redwood_requests_by_model_id. Will take ~10m.
Maya: Notifying customer that we're applying a temporary fix and will follow with a permanent dashboard update.
Tony: After we stabilize, we need: migration guide + 2-week deprecation window + dashboards updated across orgs + regression test in CI. I'll open a postmortem and add owners.
Maya: Customer replied: appreciate the quick action, will monitor. :thumbsup:
Liam: Hotpatch applied, dashboards now show per-model lines for AcmeAI. Monitoring for 15m.
Maya: Customer confirmed model breakdown returned. Leaving P1 -> P2 while we do cleanup.
Tony: Filed postmortem and migration checklist. Assigning to eng-platform and docs.
Maya: Thanks all.
